title: Three Shifts (parallel shift-change durations, expanded)
source: Hand-authored, explicit shift durations designed to exercise starts/started-by/finishes/finished-by, expanded to 6 threads / 54 events / 7 cross-thread links

events.text: Dr. Amara's ER shift begins at 7:00pm and runs until 7:00am.
Nurse Boone's ICU shift also begins at 7:00pm, but wraps up early at 1:00am.
Cole's patrol shift starts at 9:00pm, two hours after the others, and also ends at 7:00am.
At 11:00pm, Amara's team handles a mass-casualty influx lasting until 2:00am.
Her shift includes a code blue at 9:30pm that resolves by 10:15pm.
He actually begins an equipment check at 7:00pm sharp, though his official patrol doesn't start until 9:00pm.
A second ER team, led by Dr. Whit, starts its own on-call block at 7:00pm sharp too, running only until midnight.
The overnight nurse's follow-up block starts at 2:00am and, like everyone else, wraps at 7:00am.
Cole radios a final all-clear at 7:00am, the exact moment three shifts end together.
Amara's triage sub-block runs 7:00pm-9:00pm, the first two hours of her shift.
A trauma consult occupies 5:00am-7:00am, closing out the shift alongside Amara.
Overnight staffing review spans 8:00pm-6:00am, contained entirely within Amara's shift.
The second ER team's extended debrief, led by Dr. Whit, stretches from 7:00pm to 1:00am, wrapping an hour after the team's on-call block ends.
A quiet lull in the ER, 10:00pm-11:00pm, sits right before the mass-casualty influx begins at 11:00pm.
The mass-casualty aftermath cleanup runs 2:00am-4:00am, right after the influx ends, extending Amara's team's workload.
Boone's medication rounds run 7:00pm-8:00pm, the opening hour of her ICU shift.
A ventilator check spans 12:00am-1:00am, the final hour before Boone's shift wraps.
Chart audits occupy 7:30pm-12:30am, nested inside Boone's shift from start to finish.
The code blue response team's extended monitoring continues 9:30pm-11:00pm -- the same start as the code blue itself but lasting longer.
A lull before the follow-up block, 1:00am-2:00am, sits directly between Boone's shift ending and Ito's block beginning.
Ito's follow-up documentation, 2:00am-7:00am, exactly matches the full span of her clinical follow-up block.
Cole's perimeter sweep runs 9:00pm-11:00pm, the opening two hours of patrol.
A final badge-check sweep spans 5:00am-7:00am, closing out patrol alongside the all-clear.
Radio log review is nested 10:00pm-6:00am within the patrol shift.
The equipment check's paperwork tail extends 7:00pm-10:00pm -- the same start as the check itself but ending later.
His mid-shift break, 10:00pm-10:15pm, is swallowed entirely within the perimeter sweep.
A supervisor radio check spans 6:00am-7:00am, the closing hour of the badge-check sweep.
Pharmacist Reyes's overnight dispensing window opens at 7:00pm and runs until 7:00am, mirroring Amara's ER shift exactly.
A controlled-substance count runs 7:00pm-8:00pm, the opening hour of Reyes's dispensing window.
End-of-shift reconciliation spans 6:00am-7:00am, the final hour before the dispensing window closes.
Automated restock logging is nested 8:00pm-6:00am within the full dispensing window.
A STAT medication request tied to the mass-casualty influx is filled 11:15pm-11:45pm, nested inside that same 11:00pm-2:00am surge.
The night pharmacist's break, 1:00am-1:30am, falls within the restock logging block.
A narcotics audit spans 9:00pm-11:00pm, the exact same window as Cole's opening perimeter sweep, start to end.
A refrigerated-medication temperature log straddles the start of the shift, running 6:30pm-7:30pm.
The pharmacy's full-shift equipment sterilization block spans 7:00pm-7:00am as well, containing every sub-task including the 9:00pm-11:00pm narcotics audit.
Dispatcher Voss's overnight desk coverage spans 6:00pm-6:00am.
Ambulance Run 12 departs at 6:00pm and returns at 6:45pm, the opening call of the shift.
Run 13 spans 5:00am-6:00am, the last call before coverage ends.
Dispatch log review is nested 7:00pm-5:00am within the full coverage window.
Run 14 departs at 6:45pm, exactly as Run 12 returns, and lasts until 7:30pm.
Run 15 overlaps the tail of Run 14, running 7:15pm-8:00pm.
A dispatch equipment restock block spans 8:00pm-4:00am.
Run 16 spans 9:00pm-9:30pm, nested inside the equipment restock block.
Run 17, the final call, spans 5:00am-6:00am, exactly matching Run 13 in start and end.
Clerk Odom's overnight filing window spans 7:00pm-7:00am.
The intake-forms batch is filed 7:00pm-9:00pm, the opening two hours of the filing window.
The final compliance sign-off spans 6:00am-7:00am, the closing hour of the filing window.
Routine chart-stamping is nested 8:00pm-5:00am within the full filing window.
A backlog-clearing block, 9:00pm-11:00pm, begins the moment the intake-forms batch ends.
Odom's shift-note review overlaps the backlog-clearing block, spanning 10:30pm-11:30pm.
A supervisor audit block, 8:30pm-4:30am, contains the backlog-clearing block and everything logged during it.
A misfiled-report correction, 11:00pm-11:15pm, is swallowed entirely within the supervisor audit block.
The compliance sign-off and Odom's final timestamp both land at 7:00am, the instant the filing window closes.
